description: G4 blind-comparison rubric and presentation rule (ADR-0121 A2, record decision 3, proposal A2-D19 G4). Frozen with the case set: its sha256 is in g4-manifest.v1.json. The owner labels every output blind.

useless.ko: 그대로 쓸 수 없다. 주제와 어긋나거나, 지어낸 사실이 있거나, 요청한 형식(개수·목록)을 지키지 않았거나, 너무 일반적이어서 이 일정에 도움이 안 된다.
useless.en: Cannot be used as is: off-subject, invents facts, ignores the requested form (count, list), or is so generic it does not help with this event.

usable.ko: 조금 손보면 쓸 수 있다. 주제에 맞고 형식은 지켰지만 평범하거나 일부만 쓸모 있다.
usable.en: Usable with light editing: on subject and in the requested form, but ordinary or only partly useful.

good.ko: 그대로 써도 된다. 주제에 구체적이고 형식을 지켰고 군더더기가 없다.
good.en: Could be used as is: specific to the subject, in the requested form, no filler.

checks: on the event's subject (title, as shown to the arm)
respects the owner's count and list form when given
does not state an invented time, date or attendee
same language as the owner's request

pairwise.note: Ties are excluded from the binomial test; with more than 30 non-tie pairs the same one-sided test applies.

normalization: Both arms' outputs are normalized to the same generate.v1 schema, the same length cap (<= 1200 characters, <= 10 lines) and the same list format before the owner sees them; arm names are hidden.

presentationRule.caseOrder: sort case ids ascending by sha256(utf8("<seed>:order:<id>")) as lowercase hex
presentationRule.armSide: first shown arm is A when the first byte of sha256(utf8("<seed>:side:<id>")) is even, else B
presentationRule.note: No RNG library is involved, so the order is reproducible in any language.
